faq.question: What does Khalimat mean?
faq.answer: Khalimat is associated with the Arabic form خَلِيمَة, whose core sense is khalimat; halima (caucasian form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Khalimat?
faq.answer: Khalimat is associated with Arabic. Khalimat is the Caucasian form of Arabic حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma), meaning 'forbearing'.

faq.question: Is Khalimat an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form خَلِيمَة is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Khalimat an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Khalimat can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Khalimat a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Khalimat should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ḥalīma is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is kha-li-mat. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.answer: Romanization variants include Khalimat, khalimat. Script forms are حلیمه, خليمه, خلیمہ, خَلِيمَة, ख़लीमात.
